summary.name: TextMate
summary.one_liner: TextMate is an open-source, customizable text editor for macOS with support for many programming languages.
use_cases: editing source code on a Mac
making the same change at multiple places at once
searching and replacing text across files
viewing version control changes in the editor
summary.what_it_does: TextMate is a text editor for macOS that supports a large number of programming languages and markup systems. It offers multiple carets for editing several places at once and a file search view that lets you jump between matches, extract matched text, or preview replacements. Version control changes are shown in the file browser and editor, with diffs and partial commits supported for major systems. Scoped settings let different parts of a file or project use different shortcuts, settings, or formatting, and snippets, macros, and custom commands extend its behavior.
notable: Multiple carets and file search with replacement preview
Scoped settings that vary by language or scope selector
Bundles-based customization with snippets, commands, and macros
